name: GlueHook
mechanic: A pot absorbs sells at execution price and uses buys to buy back and burn.
plain: On sells of the main token a pot absorbs part of the flow at the exact execution price; on buys the pot's funds purchase more of the token and send it to a recipient or burn it. An optional hook-held LP position auto-compounds its fees.
rules: Sells are partly absorbed by a pot at the pool's execution price.
Buys spend pot funds to buy back and burn the main token.
